title: Composed supervisory control: Qualified dual-edge recorder with saturation and re-arm -> Qualified event capture with saturation

inputs.name: B_MaxCount
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Saturation limit, assumed at least one

outputs.name: B_AcceptedPulse
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Accepted event this scan

outputs.name: B_AtLimit
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Count has reached MaxCount

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
MaxCount is constant during a test and is at least 1.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Only a qualified, non-inhibited rising edge may be accepted.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Simultaneous eligible edges shall accept A only.
requirements.property: G((rose(A_EventA) AND rose(A_EventB) AND eligible) -> (A_PulseA AND !A_PulseB))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Each accepted event increments A_Count once and records A_LastSource.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Count shall saturate at A_MaxCount and latch A_Locked; A_MaxCount less than or equal to zero locks without counting.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A held-high event shall not retrigger until observed low and then rising again.
requirements.property: G((A_EventA AND prev(A_EventA))->!A_PulseA) AND G((A_EventB AND prev(A_EventB))->!A_PulseB)

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset clears A_Count, A_Locked, and A_LastSource only while both events are low.
requirements.property: G((A_Reset AND !A_EventA AND !A_EventB)->(A_Count=0 AND !A_Locked AND A_LastSource=0))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear B_Count and B_AcceptedPulse.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Only a rising B_Event edge with B_Qualify TRUE and B_Count below B_MaxCount shall increment B_Count.
requirements.property: G(B_AcceptedPulse = (rose(B_Event) AND B_Qualify AND (prev(B_Count) < B_MaxCount) AND !B_Reset))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Count shall not exceed B_MaxCount.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_AtLimit shall be TRUE exactly when B_Count is at least B_MaxCount.
A TRUE A_PulseA shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
